title: Ecosystem Building
hook: Anyone can copy a product. Copying your whole world is a lot harder.
statement: Build a world around your product, not just the product. Connected pieces make you harder to leave.
explainer: A single offer is easy to clone. Product plus content plus community plus support means a competitor has to rebuild everything. That's a real moat.
sop: List every product, service, and touchpoint you offer.
Map which ones support each other and which stand alone.
Pick one new piece that would make your core offer harder to leave.
Count your Ecosystem Depth: how many pieces actually interlock.
Connect two existing offers this quarter.
equation_example: Product, content, community, marketplace, support. That's 5 connected pieces, so Ecosystem Depth 5 gives a Moat score of 5. Higher means competitors have to rebuild your whole system. Lower means you're one easily copied offer.
question: Write down one piece you could add that would make your product harder to leave.
closing_statement: Make competitors rebuild a world, not one product.
caption:
Principle Nº 177: Ecosystem Building

Anyone can copy a product. Copying your whole world is a lot harder.

Build a world around your product, not just the product. Connected pieces make you harder to leave.

Your turn: Write down one piece you could add that would make your product harder to leave.
